novelty_flags.label: thm:complete-characterization and related_work
novelty_flags.one_line: The survey omits AboueiEtAl2024LatentSID (NeurIPS 2024), a closer latent-selection fixed-ADMG S-ID paper with selected hedges and a sound algorithm; it does not subsume the PAG-plus-conditioning target but must be positioned explicitly.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 31-34, Theorems 4.14-4.15 and Discussion, especially p. 34
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 4.15 proves sIDP completeness for unconditional selected kernels on input-free COPAGs; the Discussion states that sCIDP soundness follows from the earlier results and explicitly leaves conditional completeness and an appropriate conditional hedge analogue to future work.
The proceedings paper defines conditional PAG identification from P(V), develops CIDP, and states that Algorithm 2 is sound and complete for identifiable conditional effects without selection.
The paper reduces fixed-graph conditional identification to unconditional interventional distributions and gives a complete graphical criterion and algorithm for conditional effects.
The paper proves complete unconditional causal-effect identification from a PAG and constructs a represented-graph nonidentifiability witness after IDP failure.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 1-2 and 10; abstract, Table 1, stated contributions, and conclusion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies S-ID from P(V|S=1) to P_X(Y|S=1) with latent variables in a known augmented ADMG, introduces selected counterparts of c-components and hedges, and proves only a sufficient condition and sound algorithm while conjecturing completeness.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add Abouei et al. (NeurIPS 2024) to the bibliography and related work, then state the exact separation: known augmented ADMG versus COPAG equivalence class, P_X(Y|S=1) versus P_X(Y|C=c,S=1), and soundness-only versus the proposed binary completeness target.

Make the first three- or four-vertex bounded-search checkpoint a named proposition: either exhibit an all-fail-but-identified counterexample or certify that every all-fail instance admits a denominator-locked rational pair, including cases with informative C.

Sharpen the output-sensitive claim by specifying the certificate encoding and the residual-forest extractor's intermediate representation, so the O(3^n poly(n)+L_Gamma) target has a falsifiable bit-complexity route independent of formula evaluation.

recommended_next_step: Revise the literature map around the omitted latent-selection S-ID comparator, then advance this otherwise field-tier, semantically well-posed conditional-completeness kernel to Stage 0.
